entries.en: Houu has had troubling news of late, and desires a shorewalker's help in calming the waters.
entries.fr: Houu a reçu des nouvelles troublantes.
entries.ja: ノォヴの育成地のホォウは、厄介な情報を掴んだようだ。
entries.questName: Move Along, Nothing to Heal Here
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Warlike ways call for healing hands, and the Coral Tridents have added more sorcerers to their ranks. Houu asks you to remove at least three of them from their ranks, and thus put a damper on the Tridents' bellicose plans.
entries.fr: Les Tridents du corail ont fait appel à des mages pour renforcer leurs rangs. Avec des soigneurs parmi eux, ils risquent d'entreprendre des attaques de plus grande envergure. Houu désire que vous fassiez comprendre à trois <frnoun(BNpcName,12,2526,2,1)> que leur présence au Frai de Sapsa est malvenue.
entries.ja: ホォウから、「珊瑚の銛」が呼び寄せた、まじない師の討伐を頼まれた。サプサ産卵地の「<sheet(BNpcName,2526,0)>」を3体討伐しよう。

entries.en: Leaving the practice of medicine is a painful experience, and you are glad that the healers are not alive to dwell on it. The peaceable Houu will no doubt share your relief when you return to Novv's Nursery and report all.
entries.fr: Grâce à vous, les <frnoun(BNpcName,12,2526,2,1)> ne seront plus un problème. Allez faire votre rapport à Houu.
entries.ja: <sheet(BNpcName,2526,0)>を討伐した。ノォヴの育成地の「ホォウ」に報告しよう。

entries.en: Houu seems glad to hear of the three sorcerers' departure, though it is never easy to tell with a Sahagin. Without healers to tend to their wounded, the Coral Tridents will surely be less likely to attack in the near future─another reprieve for Novv's people.
entries.fr: Sans leurs soigneurs, la menace des Tridents du corail est sé<->rieu<->se<->ment diminuée, au grand soulagement de Houu. Ce répit est le bienvenu pour le Frai de Novv.
entries.ja: ホォウに、まじない師を討伐したことを報告した。癒し手を排除すれば、「珊瑚の銛」も下手に攻勢には出られないだろうと、ホォウは安堵したようだ。再びまじない師が呼び寄せられた際には、排除に協力しよう。
